map.库存呆滞分析 使用指南: Inventory Dead Stock Analysis User Guide
map.根据库存量、出库量、库龄计算周转天数与呆滞品比例，对库存进行分级预警，辅助清库存: From stock quantity, outbound quantity and inventory age, compute turnover days and the dead stock ratio, give graded inventory alerts and support inventory clearance decisions.
map.快消品仓月度盘点：统计周期取 90 天、呆滞阈值取 180 天，按「名称,库存量: Monthly stocktake for an FMCG warehouse: use a 90-day statistics period and a 180-day dead stock threshold, paste inventory details line by line as "name,stock qty,outbound qty,age days,unit price", and the tool computes daily average outbound, turnover days and inventory value for each SKU, plus the share of dead stock value.
map.呆滞品排序与处置：结果按周转天数降序排列，周转天数大于阈值即判定呆滞；日均出库为: Dead stock ranking and disposal: results are sorted by turnover days descending; turnover days above the threshold are judged dead stock; when daily average outbound is 0, turnover days is recorded as infinity and judged dead stock directly. When dead capital is concentrated, prioritize promotional clearance, markdowns or returns to suppliers, and check each SKU's inventory value in the detail table.
map.阈值与周期口径复核：统计周期可选 30/90/180 天，周期直接决定日均出库大: Review of the threshold and period definitions: the statistics period can be 30, 90 or 180 days and directly determines the size of daily average outbound, so it must match the finance or ERP definition; set dead stock thresholds by category (FMCG 90 days, appliances 180 days, spare parts 365 days) - after changing the threshold the conclusion on the same data may be completely different, so keep a snapshot of the inputs.
map.算例：3 个 SKU 的呆滞筛查（周期 90 天 / 阈值 180 天）: Example: dead stock screening for 3 SKUs (90-day period / 180-day threshold)
map.：输入：矿泉水,5000,12000,30,2.5；纸巾,2000,3000,4: : Input: bottled water,5000,12000,30,2.5; tissues,2000,3000,45,5; old-style cookware,800,50,220,80. Calculation: daily average outbound = outbound qty / 90 -> bottled water 133.33 units/day, tissues 33.33 units/day, old-style cookware 0.56 units/day; turnover days = stock qty / daily average outbound -> 37.5 days, 60.0 days, 1440.0 days; inventory value = stock qty x unit price -> 12500 CNY, 10000 CNY, 64000 CNY. Judgment: only old-style cookware, at 1440 turnover days > 180, is judged dead stock. Summary: 3 SKUs total, 1 dead item, total inventory value 86500 CNY, dead stock value 64000 CNY, dead stock share 74.0%, meaning inventory capital is heavily tied up in a single dead item, so the old-style cookware should be cleared first.
map.统计周期该选多少天？换周期会不会改变结论？: How many days should the statistics period be? Does changing the period change the conclusion?
map.周期必须与财务或 ERP 的出库统计口径一致，常用 90 天（一个季度）。周期越: The period must match the outbound statistics convention used by finance or the ERP; 90 days (one quarter) is common. A longer period smooths daily average outbound, while a short period is easily distorted by promotions or stockouts. For the same data, daily average outbound can differ by 6 times between a 30-day and a 180-day period, and turnover days and dead stock judgments change accordingly, so record the period and threshold for every analysis to allow comparison across periods.
map.周转天数显示 ∞ 是什么意思，怎么处理？: What does it mean when turnover days shows infinity, and how should it be handled?
map.表示该 SKU 在统计周期内出库量为 0，日均出库为 0，工具按无穷大处理并直接: It means the SKU had zero outbound quantity during the statistics period, so daily average outbound is 0; the tool treats this as infinity and directly judges it dead stock. First verify whether it is genuinely discontinued or slow-moving, or whether outbound data was not synced or its definition was missed; once confirmed, put it on the clearance list, so that missing data is not mistaken for dead stock.
